review_candidates.title: Clinical Operations Lead
review_candidates.description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview As a Clinical Operations Lead , you will provide clinical operations oversight for projects at a regional or global level, ensuring study deliverables, CRA activities and investigator sites are managed in accordance with the protocol, monitoring plan, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable local regulations. You will act as a key liaison between CRAs and the clinical project team, providing operational guidance, training and oversight throughout the study. The role will also support site start-up and feasibility, recruitment and enrolment strategies, monitoring performance, issue escalation and corrective actions, while contributing to study planning, documentation and overall project delivery. Key Responsabilities Provide oversight of regional CRAs and investigator sites, ensuring compliance with study protocols, monitoring plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines Conduct co-monitoring and CRA assessment visits as required, supporting site and CRA performance and ensuring monitoring standards are maintained Proactively monitor site and country performance, including recruitment, data collection, document collection and TMF activities, and communicate progress to the clinical project team Oversee regional site start-up and feasibility activities and support vendor management activities where required Review monitoring visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management, ensuring project deliverables are completed accurately and on time Serve as a key point of contact for regional CRAs, providing study-specific guidance, resolving issues and escalating matters to the Project Manager or relevant functions when appropriate Provide training and mentoring to CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans, guidelines and timelines, and ensure study-specific training is completed and documented Participate in Sponsor meetings and CRA calls, providing updates on country and site performance and operational progress Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies and create study tools, training materials, monitoring plans and other clinical operations documentation Support the clinical project team with study deliverables, presentations, site management activities, protocol deviations, financial project activities and other operational objectives as required Skills & Qualifications 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience required, with 7–9 years preferred Minimum 3 years of CRA experience, with strong hands-on understanding of clinical monitoring activities Post-secondary certificate/diploma required; a Bachelor’s degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Nursing or a related discipline is preferred Strong understanding of ICH-GCP, local regulations, IRB/EC requirements and Investigator responsibilities as they relate to clinical monitoring Experience working with EDC systems and clinical research documentation Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, site management, monitoring activities and study performance metrics Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with CRAs, Sponsors, investigators and cross-functional teams Strong organisational, interpersonal and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment Highly proactive, detail-oriented, task-driven and organised, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities Proficiency in Microsoft Office and demonstrated ability to prepare high-quality reports, presentations and clinical research documentation SoCRA and/or ACRP certification/designation is an advantage What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. Our Services End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading Precision medicine and biomarker solutions Real-world evidence and clinical consulting Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio How to Apply To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com. Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: Application Deadline: 27 October 2026 Department: Strategy and Impact Location: International - Africa Compensation: Ksh7,230,475 - Ksh7,850,230 / year Description Join us in creating a better world for animals At World Animal Protection, we work as one global organisation to create lasting change for animals through collaboration, partnership and collective action. We are looking for a Civil Society Engagement Manager to lead and strengthen relationships with civil society organisations, grassroots movements and key external stakeholders that can help accelerate our campaign impact across priority geographies. This role plays a critical part in helping World Animal Protection build and sustain the relationships, coalitions and networks needed to influence change. Working closely with campaign, research, advocacy and engagement colleagues, you will identify strategic opportunities, strengthen partnerships and ensure our campaigns benefit from diverse voices, shared expertise and collective action. You will lead a globally distributed team and help embed best practice in civil society engagement across campaigns and projects, including strengthening our ability to engage effectively with stakeholders in Latin America. What you will be doing Leading the coordination and delivery of civil society and grassroots engagement across priority geographies and campaign areas. Developing and implementing strategies that strengthen civil society engagement and contribute to campaign impact. Building and maintaining strategic partnerships, coalitions and alliances that support organisational priorities. Identifying opportunities to increase influence, relevance and collective impact through stronger stakeholder engagement. Providing guidance and best practice on movement building, coalition development and grassroots engagement. Monitoring external developments, stakeholder relationships and engagement opportunities that could influence campaign success. Representing World Animal Protection with civil society organisations, networks, coalitions and other external stakeholders. Leading, motivating and developing a team of Civil Society Engagement Leads to deliver high-quality outcomes and maximise impact. What we are looking for We would love to hear from you if you bring: Demonstrated experience managing and engaging civil society stakeholders across multiple geographies. Experience developing and strengthening strategic partnerships, coalitions and networks. Proven leadership experience with the ability to lead multicultural and multifunctional teams. Experience motivating and managing teams to deliver ambitious outcomes. Strong relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills, including experience representing an organisation externally. Experience identifying, developing and influencing strategic partnerships that advance campaign objectives. Strong negotiation and influencing skills and experience securing agreement across multiple stakeholders. Experience managing projects and budgets within complex programmes of work. Experience working across different countries and cultures, particularly in the Global South. Professional fluency in English and either Spanish or Portuguese, with strong written, verbal and presentation skills. Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese would be highly desirable. A strong commitment to animal welfare and the mission and values of World Animal Protection. Experience working in an international NGO, matrix organisation or supporting growth and fundraising strategies would be advantageous but is not essential. Why join World Animal Protection? This is a unique opportunity to help shape how World Animal Protection works with civil society around the world. You will play a key role in strengthening movements, partnerships and coalition-based approaches that drive meaningful change for animals, while working alongside passionate colleagues and partners across multiple regions. Benefits Annual Leave - All staff are entitled to 25 days of annual leave per calendar year. In addition, there are 2 Global Wellbeing midyear closure days and 3 additional days to be taken at the end of the calendar year (Christmas festivity), as determined by World Animal Protection. For part-time staff, holiday entitlement is prorated accordingly An increase to annual leave through length of service - 1 additional day leave after each years' service up to max 5 days. Long service milestone after 10 years and every 5 years thereafter – 1 additional day will be awarded to the employee Pension - World Animal Protection Africa has a Pension Scheme, employer contributes 6% and the employee contributes 4%. Group Life Cover - All employees are covered under GPA/WIBA cover. Medical Insurance Cover – World Animal protection has a medical insurance cover for its employees that covers; Inpatient/outpatient/maternity/Dental/Optical & counselling service. Opportunity to flex public holidays to an alternate day that better suits an employee and their beliefs. A range of 'Inclusivity Benefits': to aid belonging and inclusion at work, and to give our employees support in the moments they most need it: Study leave - 4 days Maternity leave – 3 months Paternity Leave – 2 weeks Adoption leave – 26 weeks Jury service leave Bereavement/Compassionate Leave (10days) Pregnancy Loss leave – 10 days per year Armed forces leave Carers/Dependent Leave (3 days) Disability Leave (10 days) Menstrual and Menopause Leave (12 days) Fertility Treatment Leave (5 days per cycle, up to max 3 cycles) Gender Affirming Medical Leave (20 days) Companion animal bereavement Leave (2 days) Employees are entitled to 2 days Volunteer Leave (pro-rata) a year to volunteer for a cause that matters to them Flexible working options We offer a free and confidential Employee Assistance Programme from an independent provider of employee support services. The service is there to help with a wide range of work, family and personal issues. review_candidates.title: Civil Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are a world leader in renewable energies utility looking for a highly skilled Civil Engineer with previous experience leading the civil engineering of wind farms or pv-plants in Italy. As member of an international team, you will perform a key function in the engineering of the onshore plants being developed in Italy and would be required to develop further projects in other countries, if needed. You’d play a role in the whole cycle of engineering. You will be the engineer manager responsible for leading from the technical, economic and planning point of view, the complete wind farms civil engineering and solar PV farms civil works in all phases of project development. Ensuring compliance of execution of projects targets in terms of Health, Safety and Environment, Quality, CAPEX and Schedule according with the Company Business Plan. You will work with different internal departments such as business development, offers, construction, networks, purchase, quality and environment, O&M, and also externally with developers, the Administration, certification companies, subcontractors, and others. The position will be in our offices located in Rome . Main Accountabilities Responsible for specifying the scope and design criteria of the complete wind farm and solar PV civil engineering required in each phase of the project, from bidding, due diligence, greenfield, licensing, to detailed and constructive engineering, in coordination with the different internal teams. Responsible for specifying, supervising and validating technically the services that need to be outsourced in each case, as well as coordinating with the different internal areas involved in the design of wind projects, with direct responsibility. The activities would be: Developing and validation of the basic, tendering and detailed civil engineering for Wind Farm and PV Solar Projects. Validation of wind turbine lay-out supplied by the Wind Resource team taking into account the limitations of the project (environmental, land, affected authorities, etc.), from a civil point of view. Definition and validation of the internal and external roads lay-out, crane pads (3D model) and trenches. Definition and validation of the technical solutions to be adopted in the design of the low/medium voltage evacuation infrastructures with the technical supervision of the Networks engineering team. Definition and supervision of topography works. Geotechnical works definition and supervision. Pull Out Test for PV Plant´s structures (fixed and/or tracker) Foundations for wind turbines and for PV Plant structures (fixed and/or tracker) following internal Technical Specifications. Specification and technical validation of hydrological studies and hydraulic calculations. Definition of complete project: Design of the junction projects, as well as the definitions for technical solution for the rest of the utilities affected by the project’s infrastructures. Preparation of descriptive drawings and documentation of the project in collaboration with the internal areas involved: memory, specifications, Health and Safety study, etc. Visits to the sites to analyse the location and the aspects to be considered in the design. Managing the external engineering companies responsible for providing civil engineering services. Responsible for organizing and leading the project engineering follow up meetings.. Responsible for the civil technical supervision of offers and contracts with suppliers. Responsible for reporting to the Project Manager the status of the engineering project for all scopes, identifying potential problems and solutions, monitoring the planning and action plans for delays, economic control and others. Responsible for identifying, registering and spreading the lessons learned in each of the projects to the rest of the organization and countries. Responsible for identifying potential design improvements to be requested from wind turbine manufacturers and other equipment suppliers in order to achieve continuous technical and economic improvement in the projects. Responsible for ensuring compliance with the Quality, Environmental and Health and Safety standards required by Iberdrola. Represent the company with relevant stakeholders, such as agencies and institutions, both public and private, in relation to matters relating to its responsibilities Interfaces Internal: Development department, project department (solar engineering, offers, energy resource, networks, construction), global engineering department, operation and maintenance, investment office, main equipment and contracts department, procurement department, corporate areas of the group (corporate development, control, finance, etc.), as well as other corporate departments if any. External: engineering companies, renewable developers, suppliers, technical certification companies, as well as other external companies and stakeholders if it is necessary. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, and Master's Degree in Civil Engineering. Professional Experience At least 4 years’ experience in civil engineering of wind projects and/or PV Plants in Italy. Specific Knowledge / Technical Skills / Software Requirements Expert on civil design (roads and crane pads 3D models). A basic and general knowledge in electrical design scope management is a plus Advanced knowledge in execution of hydrological and hydraulic studies. Knowledge in contracting and supervising topographic and geotechnical campaigns (also Pull Out Test campaigns). Knowledge in structural calculation of foundations with an ability to balance and prioritize competing interests. Strong knowledge of Italian civil and structural regulations, including the Italian Technical Standards for Construction (NTC), seismic design requirements and applicable regional regulations. Proven experience in managing structural and seismic authorisation and filing procedures with the competent Italian regional Civil Engineering Authorities (Genio Civile), including the coordination of external designers and technical documentation. Knowledge on construction of wind farms and solar plants is a plus. Advance user in MS Project, MS Office, AutoCad & GIS. Soft Skills Organizational skills (creating structure and order, boosting efficiency, and prioritizing task). Ability to report key indicators. Resources management. Excellent communication, diplomatic, networking and influencing skills. Understanding and alignment with corporate culture and/or ability to adapt quickly to the corporate culture. Analytical. Ability to make rational decisions, even when under pressure. Ability to take initiative. Ability to interact with contractors Strong sense of values and ethics, and confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information. Ability to work within approved budgets and under deadline pressure and deliver high quality results. Languages Italian (native). English (professional skills). Spanish is a plus. What We Offer Permanent contract with hybrid working model Benefits in accordance with the company’s welfare programmes (Life insurance, Health insurance, Insurance against occupational and non-occupational accidents, Meal vouchers, Pension fund) International mindset and innovative projects Initiatives dedicated to wellbeing Opportunities for learning, growth and cross-country collaboration.
